જોગીદાસ ખુમાણ, હાદા ખુમાણ and વજેસંગ મહારાજ are real Saurashtra figures from ઝવેરચંદ મેઘાણીની લોકકથા-પરંપરા, and 'કાઠી' and 'રાજપૂત' are real named communities in the text — use their own names as printed, never a generic label, keeping the book's own respectful register.
